summary: Help the bride and her bridesmaids look perfect on the special wedding day
description:
Our lovely girl is getting married! She has dreamed about her wedding day since she was a little girl and now the moment has finally come. Enter one of the most elegant wedding games and help the bride and bridesmaids prepare for this special event.

Getting ready for a wedding is not easy, it requires effort and fashion sense. Discover all the things you can do! The bride is going to be the center of attention, you should start with her. Enter the makeup salon and try on lovely shades of lipstick, eyeshadow, eyeliner and mascara. Create a delicate makeup look for the bride to be and after that, visit the hair salon and make sure she gets the perfect hairstyle.

The most important part of a bride look is the dress. Enter the wedding dress up level and choose carefully. The dressing room is full of all types of amazing wedding dresses and you can try all of them before you find the right one. Whatever you like, you will find it in the wedding fashion room. Don't forget to pick a nice flower bouquet and a bride veil too.

The bridesmaids will also need a fashion adviser, don't forget to play dress up with them too. You can pick matching outfits or completely different clothes for each girl. Even though the bride is the most important person at the wedding, the bridesmaids also need to shine. Do your best as a wedding stylist!

Classy Wedding Salon game features:
- a gorgeous bride and bridesmaids
- makeup, hair and dress up game levels
- wedding themed makeup, hairstyles and clothing items (dresses, blouses, skirts, accessories)
- girly graphics and intuitive gameplay
- free to play wedding game

The wedding is starting soon and our lovely girls need you! Join them right away in your next favorite wedding game. Do the bride's makeup, style her hair and find the perfect wedding dress. Then, explore different fashion options with the bridesmaids. You will never get bored with this game, let the fun begin!
